opening.argument: The video presents an operational technology demonstration, showing how software could execute a flash loan without requiring programming knowledge. The creator explains the intended interface and its use for arbitrage rather than presenting an abstract promise of returns: “somebody could just execute a flash loan without needing to do for a combo without needing to know programming.” The demonstration also exposes execution risk, reporting that a transaction failed and that gas costs produced a loss: “I've just risked to make 1 dollar 65 cents and I just lost the 65 cents because that's the cost of the gas.” Most importantly, the creator rejects any get-rich expectation, stating: “don't sign up to crypto wizards because you think you're going to get rich from arbitrage.” The communication is therefore a practical software demonstration accompanied by explicit risk disclosure, not a deceptive solicitation.
